concept: Distinguishing genuine expertise from confident-sounding misinformation in high-stakes decisions (health, finance, legal)
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.case_study: A realistic scenario where an adult must choose between conflicting advice from different sources on a high-stakes personal decision
exercise.reflection_prompt: What actually makes one source more trustworthy than another here — and what doesn't?
exercise.practice: Adult lists the specific credibility checks they'd apply before acting on either source

assessment.success_marker: adult's checks focus on track record and verifiable expertise rather than confidence of delivery or popularity
